nodes.description: External function verify_relay_staker_address(int8 workchain_id, uint256 address_body) that emits RelayAddressVerified with the caller address.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller address cast to uint160 and recorded as the verified relay address.
Function parameter int8 workchain_id supplied by the caller.
Function parameter uint256 address_body supplied by the caller.
emit RelayAddressVerified(uint160(msg.sender), workchain_id, address_body) - writes unverified caller-controlled data into the event log, which off-chain relayers may trust as an attestation.

edges.reason: Execution of the function body unconditionally reaches the emit statement.
msg.sender is converted to uint160 and flows into the RelayAddressVerified event argument without any authorisation check.
Caller-supplied workchain_id flows directly into the emitted event payload.
Caller-supplied address_body flows directly into the emitted event payload.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core parameter workchain_id has no independent semantic identity; it is only a value fed straight into the core event-emission operation.
The non-core parameter address_body is only an input slot consumed by the core event-emission operation and should be folded into it.
